bindings.SUBMISSIONS: R2 bucket for original and processed documents
bindings.OCR_PROVIDER: server-side secret/config, never exposed to browser

routes.purpose: Full skill mastery, trend, weakness state and prerequisite gaps
Create submission record and return upload instructions
Upload image/PDF to R2 for small/medium files
Run preprocessing, OCR, mark detection, question segmentation, curriculum mapping and diagnosis
Return only fields/questions requiring confirmation plus crop references
Teacher corrects OCR, mark, score, skill mapping or diagnosis
Confirm reviewed submission and make eligible evidence final
Return signed/controlled source crop for traceability
Class-level overview of students, common weaknesses and review queue

critical_rules: Original files remain immutable in R2; processed images/crops use separate keys.
No OCR/API provider key is sent to browser clients.
Questions with uncertain teacher mark or diagnosis-critical OCR remain needs_review.
Unknown prerequisite is never converted into weak prerequisite.
Teacher correction invalidates stale downstream evidence and triggers recomputation.
Every mastery claim must be traceable to question_skill_evidence and original source crop.
